description: Get the transaction template for an on-chain draft: every output to pay, plus walletcreatefundedpsbt arguments and a pay-to-many CSV on Bitcoin, or payment URIs (and calldata on EVM chains) on Solana, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon. The sender's own wallet funds, reviews and signs it; send21 contains no signing code. Not for Lightning drafts (pay their invoice). Requires scope drafts:read.
name: get_transaction_template
